ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and lower regions versus 40% high-intensity (white) pixels on the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity region forms a wide, upward-expanding 'V' shape meeting the median notch. High-intensity contiguous fields are located on the distal third of both lobes, containing scattered dark focal spots and mottling, particularly dense on the upper right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and a depth ratio of roughly 1:6 relative to the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; distinct high-amplitude jagged peaks (15-25 pixels) visible on the inner trailing edges of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Smoothly convex outer lateral edges curving upward and outward toward the high-aspect-ratio tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark circular pixel clusters (approx. 8-10) visible on the distal white field of the right lobe; sparse, smaller clusters present on the left lobe distal field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the white distal pigmentation; at least three parallel lines are visible on the right lobe and four on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, dark, irregular epibiotic growths (barnacle colonies) are present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; the trailing edge shows non-uniform, jagged tissue loss likely from prior physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely prominent cauliflower-like dark masses extending beyond the natural dermal boundary at the furthest lateral points of both fluke lobes.
